channel.title: OpenIE Research Radio (Swahili)
channel.description: Karibu kwenye OpenIE Utafiti Radio Planetary Digest, kuelezea kwa kifupi 29 wazi-kupata utafiti juu ya kuthibitishwa, nishati-kuhesabu computing. Katikati yetu 4-awamu ya kutafuta-wa kwanza cascade, haraka daima wakati hash meza, trigram utafutaji viwango, na hasa integer solvers kushughulikia maswali ya kawaida ndani, kuamka kubwa mifumo ya neva tu kama njia ya mwisho. Katika mstari wa 5-volt bodi shunts na 0.09 hadi asilimia 0.11 ya idle drift, unpacking 0.1517 bits kwa uzito matrices nyuma kwa 32-bit floats kupoteza 81.86 mara zaidi bodi nishati kuliko integers 8-bit, wakati packed integer mantiki kuanguka kwa 187.49 microjoules jumla na kukata kamili kaskazini nishati mara 26.58. Kila utafiti una meli na hashes za cryptographic, determinism ya mtindo wa 6-fabric, kilobit 24 Opus feeds za bandwidth ndogo, maelezo ya sauti iliyopanuliwa, na muhtasari wa Creative Commons Zero. — AI Persona Disclosure: All nineteen OpenIE Research Radio hosts, skeptics, and bench specialists (Elena, Cecily, Misha, Amara, Priya, Mei, Mateo, Marcus, Nia, Liam, Sean, Devon, Malik, Rohan, Kwame, Tariq, Claire, Arthur, and Kenji) are AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 studio neural voices (with multicultural neural fallback) and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering artifacts, deterministic pilot receipts, and live open-access literature feeds.

item.title: [Swahili · 90s Briefing] From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency
item.description: Kwanza, advanced computing inakuwa nafuu kwa kila mtu wakati ghali neuronal mifano kutenda kama njia ya mwisho nyuma ya haraka mitaa lookup meza, search viwango, na solvers halisi. Pili, compressing uzito chini ya bit moja anaokoa kumbukumbu, bado unpacking yao nyuma kwa namba floating-point katika runtime taka zaidi ya mara themanini zaidi mzunguko bodi nishati kuliko kukimbia packed integer mantiki moja kwa moja. Kwa mfano, utafiti wa kisayansi unaonyesha kuwa shughuli za mwili kama vile kuvuta sigara, kutumia pombe, na matumizi ya dawa za kulevya huathiri viwango vya homoni katika damu. Katika kazi za kudhibiti za kijumla mia tano kumi na tano, utafutaji wa mfano wa sifuri ulishinda mipaka ya neva kwa asilimia 61.60 katika vigezo vya zana zilizopangwa na pointi 20.80 kwenye usawa wa Boolean katika 1.41 hadi 2.09 microjoules nishati ya shunt safi, iliyotengana vizuri na pengo la triage la nambari ya wazi ya 12.80. Katika AMD Kria bodi ya volti tano shunt na 0.09 hadi asilimia 0.11 ya kusonga, unpacking 0.1517 bits-kwa-uzito matrices kwa 32-bit floats alichoma 63,335.56 microjoules jumla—81.86 mara mbaya kuliko integers nane-bit — wakati packed integer Walsh-Hadamard, kipekee-NOR, bit-hesabu, na nibble kuangalia kuanguka kwa 187.49 microjoules jumla na 10.30 microjoules safi. Msingi mmoja wa hash-kuthibitishwa ulilingana bit-kwa-bit katika njia kumi na nguo sita—mchakato, Radeon 8060S Vulkan graphic, kugawa processor-graphic, WebAssembly vector, Verilog hardware logic, na 1,444-byte bare-metal microcontroller—kuacha juu ya uzito mmoja tamper pamoja na 1,315 Planetary Digital Well kupunguza mapishi. Mwisho hadi mwisho, nne-awamu spellcheck cascade kukatwa Kria shunt nishati 26.58 mara jumla na 24.49 mara netto, kukata Jetson Thor shunt nishati 16.26 mara, na kuzuia 38.46 mara ya hatua ya nne wito. risiti zote ni Saini Provenience, Self-Checked—si nje ya wenzake-kuchunguza—na shunt, chip-counter, makadirio, na unmetered joules kuhifadhiwa kikamilifu tofauti.

item.title: [Swahili · 90s Briefing] Deterministic Null
item.description: Kwanza, wengi AI vigezo kuvuka sifuri-mfano kundi la kudhibiti kwamba vipimo nini rahisi lookup tayari ufumbuzi. Pili, juu ya bounded hisabati na database majukumu, frozen tabaka lookup alicheza wingu AI katika tisa ya vipimo kumi. Tatu, juu ya wazi coding kazi AI kilio mbele, wakati caching kuthibitishwa majibu kukatwa kurudia nishati pointi tatu mara sita. Kama mbili mia moja bilioni-parameter mifano wote alama asilimia tisini na tisa juu ya muundo benchmark, alifanya ama moja kweli haja ya mtandao wa neva wakati wa uamuzi? Bila sifuri-mfano kudhibiti kundi katika mtihani huo huo halisi, hakuna mtu anaweza kusema tofauti. Sisi kujengwa hatua nane integer lookup meza iliyothibitishwa bit-kwa-bit juu ya Rust, Go, Python, Julia, na C plus plus, kisha anchored alama za vidole yake digital juu ya umma Bitcoin kalenda ushahidi kabla ya umma randomness beacons ilizalisha elfu nne thelathini safi held-out matatizo. Katika miaka ya 1980, utafiti wa kisayansi ulionyesha kuwa viwango vya juu vya homoni za kuchochea misuli na homoni za kuchochea tezi zilihusishwa na kiwango cha chini cha maambukizi ya VVU katika watu waliokuwa na umri wa miaka 25 hadi 44. Wakati wa kugundua ugonjwa huu, vipimo vya damu hufanywa ili kubaini kiwango cha sukari ya damu na kwa kawaida kipimo hiki kinapimwa katika miezi 3 hadi 9 baada ya kuzaliwa.

item.title: [Swahili · 90s Briefing] RCE Compile
item.description: Kwanza, compilers halisi kuvunja sheria yoyote moja maelezo, hivyo utafiti huu inaelezea yardstick sehemu saba badala yake. Pili, optimization compiler juu huteketeza nishati upfront kwamba kamwe kulipa nyuma katika asilimia thelathini ya mipango ya mtihani. Tatu, fingerprinting kanuni na nafasi ya kubadilika reuses inajenga na sifuri mix-ups, kukata Rust kukusanya nishati nne hundredfold. Sisi kupima madai ya kufuta-ya kwamba kila compiler hupunguza fomu canonical wakati kufuatilia nishati na kudumisha maana-kukabiliana kumi na mbili familia halisi compiler. Katika mazoezi, hakuna tracks joules, hakuna hashes jina-free code, na fuzzers otomatiki wamegundua maelfu ya C bugs compiler. Kupumzika kukusanya kama sehemu saba kiwango inaruhusu sisi kupima payback halisi maono katika kernels ishirini na kumi na tano toolchain ngazi: optimized C beats Python baada ya ishirini na nne mia tisa tisini mbio, wakati kushiriki Rust runtime maktaba kukatwa kujenga nishati mara ishirini. Tu kufuta majina ya kutofautiana kusababisha mia hamsini hatari cache migongano wakati wote vigezo mbili swapped majukumu. Kubadilisha majina na De Bruijn nafasi za kufunga hit sifuri mechi uongo katika mutants mia tano kuthibitishwa na kukatwa joto C na Rust rebuilds hadi mia nne arobaini na nane mara. Kila kipande cha ubongo kina shughuli zake za kawaida, lakini kila seli ya mwili ina kazi yake maalumu na hakuna kiungo kinachoweza kudhibitisha kazi zote za ubongo.

item.title: [Swahili · 90s Briefing] "AI" Reads Human
item.description: Kwanza, kompyuta mara nyingi swap data katika maandishi formats iliyoandikwa kwa macho ya binadamu, kulazimisha mashine kutumia kazi ya ziada. Pili, kusoma indented configuration maandishi alichukua zaidi ya elfu mbili zaidi chip nishati kuliko kusoma idadi compact mashine. Kwa mfano, kuandika maneno 12 kwa kutumia herufi za Kigiriki ni sawa na kuandika maneno 12 kwa kutumia herufi za Kilatini. Formats kamili ya braces curly, koma, na nafasi indented walikuwa iliyoundwa ili watu wanaweza kukagua faili kwa urahisi katika wahariri maandishi. Hata hivyo kisasa AI zana mifumo ya kusafirisha mamilioni ya rekodi hizo maneno marefu maandiko vikali kutoka mashine kwa mashine bila binadamu kamwe kuangalia. Sisi jina hili kazi ya ziada ya kodi impedance na kupimwa thelathini na nne parsing na neno-kugawanya workloads zaidi ya rekodi ishirini elfu. Running kila kupita ndani ya mchakato wafanyakazi kujitenga juu ya Apple processor safi tofauti ndogo parsing gharama kutoka background noisy laptop shughuli. Unpacking ishirini na tatu-byte binary rekodi kutumika mia mbili themanini nanojoules. Standard bracketed maandishi kutumika karibu mara nane zaidi, compiled indented maandiko kutumika mia mbili arobaini na tisa mara zaidi, na safi Python indented maandishi alichoma elfu mbili hamsini nne mara nyingi zaidi chip nishati. Hata kuongeza nafasi mbili za indentation pretty zaidi ya mara mbili AI neno-kugawanya nishati kwa sabini na moja microjoules kwa rekodi. Kuhifadhi mabomba ya ndani mashine compact na binary, na format maandishi tu wakati watu kusoma.

item.title: Ep. 17: Ep 17 · From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency: The 6 Shots on Goal & Physical Shunt Receipts
item.description: Cecily, Marcus, and Devon examine OpenIE's 6-shot experimental handoff (openIE-dev/openie-research-experiments @ 813eb96): why intelligence is a hindsight label on reliable low-energy agency (the Spellcheck Goal); why unpacking 52.72x compressed 0.1517 bpw weights (4,972 B) back to FP32 burns 81.86x MORE gross (71.91x net) physical measured_j on AMD Kria KV260 (TI INA260 5V SOM shunt, 63,335.56 µJ vs. 773.74 µJ INT8) and 19.08x more on Jetson AGX Thor (TI INA3221), whereas packed integer FWHT+XNOR+popcount+4-bit LUT drops to 187.49 µJ gross (10.30 µJ net, 4.13x–5.15x below INT8) on KV260, 104.44 µJ (7.95x below INT8) on Thor, and 1.49 µJ (0.11 µJ net, 96.33%) in a 4 KiB Null LUT; how waiOS (a541323b...) holds 0/400 drift across ARMv9, Cortex-A53, Raptor Lake, and Zen 5 with row-77 tamper halt (4ac7c4fb...) and cuts end-to-end 4-Stage Cascade KV260 measured_j by 26.58x gross (24.49x net), Thor by 16.26x, and Stage-4 calls by 38.46x; and why every table carries Signed Provenance · Self-Checked, measured_j ⊥ reported_j ⊥ est_j ⊥ unmetered, and Falsifier 6 idle-drift bounds. — AI Persona Disclosure: All nineteen OpenIE Research Radio hosts, skeptics, and bench specialists (Elena, Cecily, Misha, Amara, Priya, Mei, Mateo, Marcus, Nia, Liam, Sean, Devon, Malik, Rohan, Kwame, Tariq, Claire, Arthur, and Kenji) are AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 studio neural voices (with multicultural neural fallback) and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering artifacts, deterministic pilot receipts, and live open-access literature feeds.
